We need to generate high-quality unit test code for getSectionRRsets covering all cases from JSON. The provided test class already covers some cases, but we need to incorporate all groups. We can modify/extend the test class, adding more test methods, using reflection for private fields (sections array) to simulate null array, insufficient length, null record, etc. Also need to test invalid section handling (negative and > max). Already have invalidSectionThrowsException with 4; but need -1 and 5; also test Section.check throws IllegalArgumentException for -1 and 5. Use parameterized test.

Also need to test null internal sections array causing NPE via reflection set field to null.

Insufficient sections array length causing AIOOBE.

Null record in list causing NPE.

Record.sameRRset throws RuntimeException propagation: need custom Record subclass.

Also test empty but non-null section list returns mutable empty list (size 0) not Collections.emptyList().

All records distinct RRsets: three records with different name/type/class.

Some records share same RRset: 2 same, 1 different.

Multiple records map to same existing RRset after several iterations: 3 same, 1 distinct.

RRset order follows first occurrence.

Returned list fresh each call.

Upper valid section index with null slot returns empty collection.

Empty section returns empty list (already covered).

Also test null section list returns empty collection (already covered).

Need to use Message.addRecord to populate sections; but for some tests we need to directly set sections array with custom lists (including null record). Since addRecord creates sections array and list; we can use reflection to set sections.

We need to import necessary classes: org.xbill.DNS.*, java.util.*, java.net.*, org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource, org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName.

We'll write helper methods to set internal sections via reflection.

Also need to create custom Record subclass that overrides sameRRset to throw exception.

Implementation details: Use reflection:

Field sectionsField = Message.class.getDeclaredField("sections"); sectionsField.setAccessible(true); sectionsField.set(message, null); etc.

For insufficient length: sections = new List[2]; sectionsField.set(message, sections);

For null record: List<Record> list = new ArrayList<>(); list.add(null); sections[1] = list;

For empty but non-null: sections[0] = new ArrayList<>(); (list empty). Then call getSectionRRsets and verify list is mutable (i.e., not Collections.emptyList()). Since returned list is LinkedList, we can add element and see no exception.

Check that returned list is mutable: try add a dummy RRset (maybe null) and ensure no UnsupportedOperationException.

For fresh instance: call getSectionRRsets twice, modify first list, ensure second not affected.

For order test: verify order of RRsets matches first occurrence.

We need to create records: ARecord, MXRecord etc. Use Name.fromConstantString.

Now produce final test class code.

We must keep existing tests as they are, maybe add more.

Let's craft final code.
